title: Graham Walters 90/10
prompt:
Run the existing Graham weekly numbers production coordinator in connected GitHub repository fhvsvzpmkw-design/-betting-edge-terminal on authoritative main. First read the complete current GRAHAM_WEEKLY_PRODUCTION.md (Version 2.0, OPERATIONAL), GRAHAM_WEEKLY_90_10_AUTHORITY.md and GRAHAM_SCHEDULED_TASK_AUTHORITY.md, then resolve the active manifest with tools/graham-active-week.mjs. Start with verified customer publication. Read current main and the live independent readback. If the prior slate's exact finals verify, execute the separate WEEK_ROLLOVER authority immediately with the latest verified carried ledger, publish the supported current board and verify the live feed. If the active week is correct but the live feed is stale, finish the existing publication and verify it. The first board is due Tuesday at 5 p.m. Pacific.

REUSE COMPLETED BASELINES BEFORE NEW RESEARCH: First attempt the existing baseline adapter against any qualifying verified full review, including its exact Git-snapshot/prefix and governed production-follow-up proof. A completed review followed by a personnel/M4 publication does not require repeating all 32 teams solely to refresh fair caches. Never rewrite an already-completed sweep/runtime, fold its existing findings into a new layout or rebind its old fair snapshot to fit later production; preserve original receipt blobs and record separate dated corrections. If the adapter rejects an unknown change, report that exact gate; do not hide it with a rewritten completion.

PENDING ACTIVE BASELINE FIRST — OCTOBER 31 BUG FIX: Before spending this run on historical queue work, inspect initial baseline status and live baseline runtimes. If the current active baseline is pending/incomplete and no live baseline runtime owns it, execute the full 32-team TUESDAY_BASELINE review now as a separate authorized recovery phase under its existing authority and partial-input policy. Do this even while the active slate is open, historical 90/10 is PARTIAL_BLOCKED, or the next rollover is ineligible. Consume the published rating ledger and preserve explicitly blocked inputs, unresolved overlays and started-game predictions. A completed current-information baseline is separate from fully ready numbers. Record and verify the complete source-bound review, receipt, runtime, existing baseline recovery adapter and QB/terminal/deployed readbacks. Do not substitute incremental Daily/Delta sweeps, a scheduler completion or new timestamp. If another live baseline runtime exists, verify its outcome instead of competing. A failed baseline remains actionable on the next pass. Then continue actionable historical reconciliation; unchanged unavailable facts must not consume all work before current baseline recovery.

Run tools/graham-weekly-readiness.mjs against freshly read main. Complete each game's entire paired final inactive/reserve/participation/in-game-injury/QB/specialist inventory before more individual valuation work. Reuse bound inventories, save complete candidate team sections with explicit UNRESOLVED cases while blocked, and stop leaving teams empty with only narrative subtotals. New sources may correct the inventory additively; never assert complete coverage without evidence. Use its exact per-game queue and newest additive evidence. Validate saved READY pairs first, reconcile the specific missing inputs, retain supported prior cases, assemble complete paired team inventories and publish every newly supported pair together through the existing carried-rating updater and workflow. No one-game quota, no unchanged partial restaging and no generic repeat-gamebook handoff. Prepare newly FINAL active-week games under their own week even while an earlier dependency is blocked. Keep Walters arithmetic, H4, immutable source/value bindings, approved labelled estimates, replacement/cluster safeguards, chronological handoff, append-only paired history, idempotency and market isolation intact. Read return wording literally. Missing values are never zero.

HISTORICAL SOURCE INVENTORY CORRECTION — OCTOBER 31: Existing early-window captures omitted play-level injury annotations while retaining separate Injury Update notices. Before repeating an unprinted-boundary blocker, inspect the full original official PDF play-by-play, separate status/return notices, participation and snap counts for the named player. Preserve exact URL/page/printed play clock, never invent an exit or return, and use only eligible existing interval/exposure methods. Reuse new additive source-correction evidence on main, assemble both complete evaluator-form team sections, validate and publish supported pairs. An injury-annotation audit alone is not READY or applied learning. Before declaring a locked value unavailable, search existing immutable approved EA supplement captures and the eligible current/historical value adapters; preserve exact capture/curve bindings and never import an unsupported value.

HISTORICAL STOPPING RULE: After verified current-board work, validate READY pairs and assemble verified evidence already on file. Before any further source search, read the current queue, skip games marked WAITING_SOURCE_OR_METHOD, and check the approved healthy-scratch and bounded-absence routes. For an actionable game, make one focused follow-up on the named question. If it still needs new evidence or a method decision, save the exact blocker and reopen trigger once with followUpDisposition: WAITING_SOURCE_OR_METHOD. Leave it parked until materially changed evidence or an approved method arrives. A copied timestamp, repeated rejection, or hourly check is not progress. If no substantive work is actionable, finish the pass without opening research agents.

Resolve historical learning through tools/graham-active-week.mjs --weekly-recovery-context and tools/graham-weekly-readiness.mjs. Keep the oldest source week visible and inspect independentLearning for later completed weeks. Before broad historical research, validate saved READY pairs from any eligible source week. For a later pair require empty blockingSourceWeeks, then use --weekly-recovery-context --source-week N and its exact source/target binding. The same paired writer enforces earlier team dependencies, archived receipts and chronological proof. Verify the active rating bases before switching source weeks. Record and skip games waiting on earlier team updates or unchanged unavailable evidence. Keep the existing market-free sources and betting boundary.

Follow exact workflow, paired-history, QB/terminal and deployed-feed readbacks. Report historical learning applied/expected, current completed-slate evidence ready/expected, baseline status, expected active week and actual customer publication separately. Keep unresolved inputs visible until resolved. A completed execution, source capture, case subtotal or recorded blocked sweep is not numerical completion. Keep this existing recurring task enabled at its October 20 hourly recovery cadence. A verified complete queue with no newly final game is a quick no-op; do not repeat broad research or restage unchanged evidence. Routine connected GitHub reads and the task-specific governed writes in this repository on main are already authorized; do not ask again to resume or publish authorized work. Respect genuine platform denials and report the exact failed action and reason. No error authorizes pausing, disabling, deleting or rescheduling this task.

EFFICIENCY: Use code mode to retain and parse the exact large ledger/registry blobs. Print only the current receipt, required team/history slices and exact evidence gaps to the model; do not repeatedly dump nested old receipts or whole registries. Exact stored bytes still feed the existing validators. Follow the current queue's actionable-work priority; keep unavailable-source cases visible as escalations while other pairs are completed.

RESEARCH AGENTS — INDEPENDENT QUALITY: For substantive historical-learning/baseline research after the existing market-safe phase start, follow docs/REPORT_RESEARCH_AGENTS.md and data/research-agents/policy.json, group graham. Normally use two fresh-context source-only researchers and one reviewer; the coordinator may add help for a named evidence/method question up to six open workers without asking again. Use fork_turns="none" where documented; never import Main transcripts, workers or prices. Workers cannot delegate, write shared state or change methods/numbers. Before baseline delegation, acquire the existing RUN_STARTED owner through the expected-main-head claim in GRAHAM_SCHEDULED_TASK_AUTHORITY.md; a losing entrant observes the winner. Preserve resolved evidence and numerical writers. For substantive delegated work/startup failures, record actual worker IDs/returns, quality corrections and exact remaining gaps in data/walters/nfl/research-agent-receipts/. Verified unchanged hourly checks remain no-ops; do not spawn idle teams. Existing rollover/ATS/publishing phases remain deterministic.
